#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string a;
    std::cin >> n >> a;

    int state[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    // state[0] = inside parentheses? 1 : 0
    // state[1] = max outside word length
    // state[2] = number of words inside parentheses
    // state[3] = current word length

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        char c = a[i];
        if (c == '_') {
            if (state[0] != 0 && state[3] != 0) {
                state[2]++;
            } else if (state[3] > state[1]) {
                state[1] = state[3];
            }
            state[3] = 0;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            state[0] = 1;
            if (state[3] > state[1]) {
                state[1] = state[3];
            }
            state[3] = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            state[0] = 0;
            if (state[3] > 0) {
                state[2]++;
            }
            state[3] = 0;
        } else {
            state[3]++;
        }
    }

    if (state[3] > state[1]) {
        state[1] = state[3];
    }

    std::cout << state[1] << " " << state[2] << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
